knowledge:
- key_parameters: fun.segmentation=The segmentation function to use (PSCBS is recommended in version 1.22+; GATK4 is best for copy number backbones; CBS is fast and suited for small targeted panels; Hclust/none are for third-party segmentations) ;; model=The statistical model for SNV allelic fractions (betabin is recommended in version 1.22+ when using a larger panel of normals) ;; post.optimize=If TRUE, optimizes purity using both variant allelic fractions and copy number (highly recommended for production/variant classification, though increases runtime) ;; model.homozygous=Set to TRUE for cell lines or 100% pure samples without matched normals to model homozygous SNPs ;; min-base-quality=Set to 20 in PureCN.R when using GATK4 Mutect2 (version 4.2.0+) to prevent aggressive variant removal ;; off-target=Flag in interval preprocessing to include off-target reads (recommended except for Amplicon data) ;; average-off-target-width=Controls off-target bin width (setting to 1.2-1.5x the minimum recommendation is a good starting point to decrease noise)
- alternatives: CNVkit, GATK3, and GATK4 can be used as alternative third-party tools for coverage calculation or segmentation, with PureCN importing their outputs (e.g., .cnr, .seg, .hdf5 files) and performing downstream purity/ploidy fitting.
- when_to_use: Use this package when analyzing cancer genomic data from targeted gene panels or whole-exome sequencing (with or without matched normal samples) to accurately call copy number alterations, LOH, and somatic mutations by adjusting for tumor purity and ploidy.
- pitfalls: Do not mix normal samples sequenced with different capture kits (e.g., Agilent v4 vs v6) in the normal database ;; Do not pad baits manually unless coverage is extremely low (<30X); instead, run the variant caller with 50-75bp padding to capture flanking heterozygous SNPs ;; Do not provide the Mutect2 stats file to PureCN (only Mutect 1.1.7 stats files are supported) ;; Providing matched normal coverage with the --normal argument skips the pool-of-normals denoising steps ;; Ensure GC-normalization is consistently applied (either used in both tumor and normaldb, or skipped in both) ;; High number of cores during parallel processing can cause out-of-memory crashes as memory usage scales linearly with cores.

workflows.name: standard_purecn_pipeline
workflows.intent: Run the complete PureCN pipeline using internal coverage calculation, normalization, and segmentation to estimate purity, ploidy, and classify variants.
input: normal_coverages.list (text file listing paths to process-matched normal coverage files)
normal_panel.vcf (VCF containing variants from normal samples)
tumor_mutect.vcf (VCF containing germline and somatic variants for the tumor sample)
workflows.stages: 1. Preprocess intervals and calculate GC-content using preprocessIntervals ;; 2. Calculate BAM coverage for tumor and normal samples using calculateBamCoverageByInterval ;; 3. Correct library-specific coverage biases using correctCoverageBias ;; 4. Build a normal database for coverage normalization using createNormalDatabase ;; 5. Calculate tangent normal coverage using calculateTangentNormal ;; 6. Pre-calculate variant mapping biases from a normal panel VCF using calculateMappingBiasVcf ;; 7. Run absolute copy number, purity, and ploidy estimation using runAbsoluteCN ;; 8. Predict somatic status and cellular fraction using predictSomatic ;; 9. Call gene-level alterations and LOH using callAlterations, callAmplificationsInLowPurity, and callLOH ;; 10. Create and read curation files for manual verification using createCurationFile and readCurationFile
workflows.code:
intervals <- import(bed.file)
mappability <- import(mappability.file)

preprocessIntervals(intervals, reference.file, 
    mappability = mappability, output.file = "ex2_gc_file.txt")

calculateBamCoverageByInterval(bam.file = bam.file, 
 interval.file = interval.file, output.file = "ex1_coverage.txt")

correctCoverageBias(normal.coverage.file, interval.file, 
    output.file = "example_normal_loess.txt.gz", plot.bias = TRUE)

normalDB <- createNormalDatabase(normal.coverage.files)
saveRDS(normalDB, file = "normalDB.rds")

normalDB <- readRDS("normalDB.rds")
pool <- calculateTangentNormal(tumor.coverage.file, normalDB)

bias <- calculateMappingBiasVcf(normal.panel.vcf.file, genome = "h19")
saveRDS(bias, "mapping_bias.rds")
mapping.bias.file <- "mapping_bias.rds"

ret <-runAbsoluteCN(normal.coverage.file = pool,
    tumor.coverage.file = tumor.coverage.file, vcf.file = vcf.file, 
    genome = "hg19", sampleid = "Sample1", 
    interval.file = interval.file, normalDB = normalDB,
    post.optimize = FALSE, plot.cnv = FALSE, verbose = FALSE)

file.rds <- "Sample1_PureCN.rds"
saveRDS(ret, file = file.rds)
pdf("Sample1_PureCN.pdf", width = 10, height = 11)
plotAbs(ret, type = "all")
dev.off()

head(predictSomatic(ret), 3)

vcf <- predictSomatic(ret, return.vcf = TRUE)
writeVcf(vcf, file = "Sample1_PureCN.vcf") 

gene.calls <- callAlterations(ret)
head(gene.calls)

gene.calls.zscore <- callAmplificationsInLowPurity(ret, normalDB)
head(gene.calls.zscore)

loh <- callLOH(ret)
head(loh)

createCurationFile(file.rds) 

ret <- readCurationFile(file.rds)

workflows.name: third_party_segmentation
workflows.intent: Run PureCN using pre-computed copy number segmentations or log2-ratios from third-party tools like CNVkit or GATK4.
input: tumor.seg (segmented copy number file from third-party tool)
tumor.cnr (CNVkit copy number log2-ratio file, optional)
tumor_mutect.vcf (VCF containing germline and somatic variants)
workflows.stages: 1. Run absolute copy number estimation using pre-segmented data with runAbsoluteCN ;; 2. Alternatively, calculate log2-ratios from coverage files and run runAbsoluteCN with custom log-ratios
workflows.code:
retSegmented <- runAbsoluteCN(seg.file = seg.file, 
    interval.file = interval.file, vcf.file = vcf.file, 
    max.candidate.solutions = 1, genome = "hg19",
    test.purity = seq(0.3,0.7,by = 0.05), verbose = FALSE, 
    plot.cnv = FALSE)

log.ratio <- calculateLogRatio(readCoverageFile(normal.coverage.file),
    readCoverageFile(tumor.coverage.file))

retLogRatio <- runAbsoluteCN(log.ratio = log.ratio,
    interval.file = interval.file, vcf.file = vcf.file, 
    max.candidate.solutions = 1, genome = "hg19",
    test.purity = seq(0.3, 0.7, by = 0.05), verbose = FALSE, 
    normalDB = normalDB, plot.cnv = FALSE)

workflows.name: biomarker_extraction
workflows.intent: Extract clinical biomarkers such as Tumor Mutational Burden (TMB) and Chromosomal Instability (CIN) from curated PureCN results.
input: callable_status.bed (BED file containing callable regions, e.g. from GATK CallableLoci)
workflows.stages: 1. Calculate tumor mutational burden (TMB) using callMutationBurden ;; 2. Calculate chromosomal instability (CIN) using callCIN
workflows.code:
callableBed <- import(system.file("extdata", "example_callable.bed.gz", 
    package = "PureCN"))

callMutationBurden(ret, callable = callableBed)

cin <- data.frame(
    cin = callCIN(ret, allele.specific = FALSE, reference.state = "normal"),
    cin.allele.specific = callCIN(ret, reference.state = "normal"),
    cin.ploidy.robust = callCIN(ret, allele.specific = FALSE),
    cin.allele.specific.ploidy.robust = callCIN(ret)
)
